title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3: Efficient and Open Intelligence
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型家族白皮书与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 希望区分公开、门控与私有训练材料，并审计多环境 RL 复现边界的研究者
one_line: Nemotron 3 documents multi-environment RL and broad weights/data/recipe releases, while retaining proprietary or gated source boundaries and incomplete per-environment audit detail.
Nemotron 3 披露多环境 RL 以及广泛的权重、数据和 recipe 发布，但仍保留专有或门控来源边界与不完整的逐环境审计细节。
why: It separates official artifacts and reference recipes from the missing source allocations, environment pins, rollout logs, reward calibration, and rights mapping needed to reproduce the full family.
inclusion_reason: A frontier family report with multi-environment RL and broad official artifacts, but proprietary/gated-source boundaries and reproducibility/audit gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
A frontier model family can be described as open because it releases weights, software, recipes, and some data, while still leaving the full training system impossible to reconstruct. For a multi-environment reinforcement-learning pipeline, reproducibility depends on the allocation of sources to models, task and environment revisions, rollout groups, reward definitions, rejected samples, and data rights—not only on the presence of public checkpoints.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 exposes more of this surface than many model reports. Its family white paper names simultaneous multi-environment RL, its public Nano release documents data classes and parts of the post-training pipeline, and NVIDIA publishes developer recipes and datasets. However, the official materials also distinguish publicly releasable data from gated material and from private third-party or NVIDIA-internal data, and they do not provide an immutable family-wide training manifest.

一个前沿模型家族可以因发布权重、软件、recipe 和部分数据而被称为开放，同时仍无法重建完整训练系统。对多环境强化学习管线而言，可复现性取决于来源到模型的分配、任务和环境版本、rollout 组、reward 定义、拒绝样本与数据权利，而不只取决于是否存在公开 checkpoint。

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 比许多模型报告披露了更多此类表面。其家族白皮书点名同时进行的多环境 RL，公开 Nano 发布记录了数据类别和部分后训练管线，NVIDIA 也发布了开发者 recipe 与数据集。不过，官方材料同样区分了可公开再发布的数据、门控材料以及私有第三方或 NVIDIA 内部数据，并且没有提供不可变的家族级训练 manifest。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Nemotron 3 is a Nano, Super, and Ultra model family based on a hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts architecture. The family report states that models are post-trained with a diverse collection of RL environments for reasoning, multi-step tool use, and inference-time reasoning-budget control. Rather than using separate task stages, the report says these environments are optimized simultaneously.

The disclosed feedback surface is mixed and task-dependent. The family report specifies asynchronous RL with training and inference decoupled, GRPO, and masked importance sampling. Nano release material adds examples of automated compiler, numerical, and language checks, while NVIDIA reference documentation names additional Nano components such as GenRM and DPO. A complete mapping from each environment to its reward, verifier, dataset, and model is not disclosed.

The central Track 12 contribution is therefore a release and disclosure ledger. It distinguishes a publicly visible software and artifact stack from the still-partial record of data allocation, gating, private inputs, environment state, and feedback calibration.

Nemotron 3 是由 Nano、Super 和 Ultra 组成的家族，采用 hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts 架构。家族报告称模型通过多样的 RL 环境进行后训练，以获得推理、多步工具使用和推理时 reasoning-budget control 能力。报告称这些环境被同时优化，而不是按任务分别设置训练阶段。

已披露的反馈表面是混合且依任务而定的。家族报告说明了训练与推理解耦的异步 RL、GRPO 和 masked importance sampling。Nano 发布材料补充了自动编译器、数值和语言检查等例子；NVIDIA 参考文档还点名了 GenRM、DPO 等 Nano 组件。每个环境对应的 reward、verifier、数据集和模型的完整映射尚未披露。

因此，Track 12 的核心价值是一份发布与披露账本。它区分了公开可见的软件和 artifact 栈，与仍然不完整的数据分配、门控、私有输入、环境状态和反馈校准记录。

title: Method
方法
html:
The family RL environments cover mathematics and scientific reasoning, competitive coding, instruction following, software engineering, search, chat, general agentic tool use, and long-context tasks. The report says all of these task families are trained simultaneously. It describes asynchronous RL that decouples training from inference, uses the models' throughput for rollouts, and applies GRPO with masked importance sampling to account for rollout-policy differences.

For Nano, official model documentation describes a mixture of public, crawled, synthetic, private third-party, and NVIDIA-internal sources. It states that synthetic post-training records can include distilled trajectories, solutions, and translations from strong teacher models and agent systems. It describes quality controls that remove malformed examples and repeated reasoning, use automated compiler, numerical, and language checks, and apply targeted content filters. Exact prompts, per-source mixture weights, teacher routing, yields, rejected records, and assignments to Nano, Super, or Ultra remain unknown.

The public release boundary is material. Nano weights and selected final pre- and post-training data are released; the model card says a sample is ungated, while remaining code, math, and multilingual data require gating and approval. NVIDIA developer recipes are open-source-data reference implementations, and NVIDIA states that their results differ from technical-report benchmarks that used additional proprietary data. Private third-party and NVIDIA-internal data are listed in the Nano documentation but not made publicly accessible.

家族 RL 环境覆盖数学和科学推理、竞赛编程、指令遵循、软件工程、搜索、聊天、通用智能体工具使用和长上下文任务。报告称所有这些任务族被同时训练。它描述了训练与推理解耦的异步 RL，利用模型吞吐量生成 rollout，并采用 GRPO 与 masked importance sampling 来处理 rollout policy 差异。

对 Nano，官方模型文档描述了公开、爬取、合成、私有第三方和 NVIDIA 内部来源的混合。它称合成后训练记录可包括由强教师模型和 agent 系统蒸馏的轨迹、解答和翻译。文档描述了移除畸形样本和重复推理的质量控制、自动编译器/数值/语言检查，以及定向内容过滤。精确 prompt、逐来源混合权重、教师路由、产出比例、拒绝记录以及分配到 Nano、Super 或 Ultra 的关系仍为 unknown。

公开发布边界具有实质影响。Nano 权重和选定的最终预训练、后训练数据被发布；模型卡说明样本无需门控，而剩余的代码、数学和多语言数据需要门控与批准。NVIDIA 开发者 recipe 是开源数据 reference implementation，NVIDIA 说明其结果会不同于使用额外专有数据的技术报告 benchmark。Nano 文档列出了私有第三方和 NVIDIA 内部数据，但它们未向公众开放。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official family paper identifies Nano, Super, and Ultra and reports multi-environment RL, simultaneous training across task families, asynchronous train/inference decoupling, GRPO, masked importance sampling, up to 1M-token context, and inference-time reasoning-budget control. It also states an intention to release weights, software, recipes, and data for which NVIDIA holds redistribution rights.

The official Nano model card gives a more detailed but model-specific disclosure. Its data table lists 141 datasets and 10,648,823,153,919 tokens, while separate text states that Nano was trained for approximately 25T tokens. It identifies public, crawled, synthetic, private third-party, and NVIDIA-internal data classes, and says that final pre- and post-training data are released with a mix of ungated samples and gated or approval-required material.

The official developer repository documents that its open recipes use only the open-source subset of the data and can differ from technical-report results that used additional proprietary data. These sources support a partial-release, mixed-data assessment. They do not establish a complete family-wide mapping of sources, rewards, environments, rollouts, and benchmarks.

官方家族论文识别出 Nano、Super 和 Ultra，并报告多环境 RL、跨任务族的同时训练、训练/推理解耦的异步方式、GRPO、masked importance sampling、最高 1M-token 上下文以及推理时 reasoning-budget control。它还称将发布 NVIDIA 拥有再发布权的数据、软件、recipe 和权重。

官方 Nano 模型卡给出了更详细但仅限模型的披露。其数据表列出 141 个数据集和 10,648,823,153,919 个 token，而另一处正文称 Nano 约训练了 25T token。它识别公开、爬取、合成、私有第三方和 NVIDIA 内部数据类别，并称最终预训练与后训练数据已发布，其中混合了无需门控的样本和需要门控或批准的材料。

官方开发者仓库说明其开放 recipe 只使用数据的开源子集，结果可能不同于使用额外专有数据的技术报告结果。这些来源支持部分发布、混合数据的判断，但不能建立来源、reward、环境、rollout 和 benchmark 的完整家族级映射。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Nemotron 3 is notable not merely for releasing model weights, but for exposing several layers that are often collapsed in frontier reports: a family-level multi-environment RL design, open post-training software, documented data classes, selected released training data, and an explicit redistribution-rights boundary. The Nano documentation makes private, gated, and publicly accessible material visible as different release states instead of implying that all named data is equally open.

For this atlas, the important contribution is an auditable disclosure pattern. The public reference recipes and data catalogue are useful artifacts, but the repository explicitly distinguishes them from reported runs that included additional proprietary data. This makes the work a strong example of why an open recipe can be evidence about method while still not being evidence of full-report reproducibility.

Nemotron 3 的重要性不只在于发布模型权重，还在于暴露了前沿报告常被压缩在一起的多个层面：家族级多环境 RL 设计、开放的后训练软件、已记录的数据类别、部分发布的训练数据，以及明确的再发布权边界。Nano 文档将私有、门控和公众可访问材料展示为不同发布状态，而不是暗示所有被点名的数据同样开放。

对本图谱而言，重要贡献是一种可审计的披露模式。公开 reference recipe 和数据目录是有用 artifact，但仓库明确把它们与包含额外专有数据的报告运行区分开。这使该工作成为有力例子：开放 recipe 可以是方法证据，却仍不是完整报告可复现性的证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The family paper does not publish an immutable end-to-end manifest linking every source, sample, synthetic trace, environment revision, rollout, reward, checkpoint, and benchmark result. Per-environment terminal predicates, reward functions, calibration, thresholds, false-accept or false-reject behavior, rollout groups, and reward-hacking audits are incomplete or unknown.

The release is not uniform. Some Nano data is public, some is gated or approval-required, and documentation lists private third-party and NVIDIA-internal data. The family-level redistribution-rights mapping, source licenses, and allocation to Nano, Super, and Ultra are unknown. An open-data reference recipe cannot reproduce runs that used additional proprietary data.

The Nano model card presents 141 datasets and 10.648T tokens in one data table but separately states approximately 25T training tokens. Without an immutable mixture ledger and definitions of these figures, the relationship between the two counts cannot be resolved from the official materials. The table's Training 100%, testing 0%, and validation 0% statement does not substitute for task-level public train/evaluation splits or a family-wide overlap audit.

家族论文没有发布不可变的端到端 manifest，用于连接每个来源、样本、合成轨迹、环境版本、rollout、reward、checkpoint 和 benchmark 结果。逐环境终止谓词、reward 函数、校准、阈值、假接受或假拒绝行为、rollout 组和 reward-hacking 审计均不完整或为 unknown。

发布并不均一。部分 Nano 数据公开，部分需要门控或批准，文档还列出私有第三方和 NVIDIA 内部数据。家族级再发布权映射、来源许可证以及分配到 Nano、Super 和 Ultra 的情况均为 unknown。仅使用开放数据的 reference recipe 无法复现使用额外专有数据的运行。

Nano 模型卡在一张数据表中展示 141 个数据集和 10.648T token，却在另一处称约训练了 25T token。没有不可变的混合账本和这些数值的定义，无法只凭官方材料解决两种计数的关系。表中 Training 100%、testing 0%、validation 0% 的陈述不能替代任务级公开训练/评估切分或家族级重叠审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
This report is useful for auditing the phrase "open model" at multiple layers. Readers can separately record released weights, public software, open-subset reference recipes, released data, gated data, private data, and unresolved redistribution rights. It also provides a concrete example of how a multi-environment RL claim should be decomposed into task families, environment versions, terminal predicates, rewards, rollouts, and calibration.

For reproducibility work, the open recipes are valuable reference implementations, but they should be evaluated as open-subset methods rather than as the complete production recipe. A full audit would require immutable source manifests, source-to-model allocation, data licenses and gates, environment and benchmark revisions, rollout and rejection logs, reward definitions, calibration results, and a documented overlap protocol.

该报告有助于在多个层面审计“开放模型”这一说法。读者可以分别记录已发布权重、公开软件、开源子集 reference recipe、已发布数据、门控数据、私有数据和未解决的再发布权。它还提供了具体案例，说明多环境 RL 主张应拆分为任务族、环境版本、终止谓词、reward、rollout 和校准。

对可复现性工作，开放 recipe 是有价值的 reference implementation，但应作为开源子集方法评估，而不是完整生产配方。完整审计需要不可变来源 manifest、来源到模型的分配、数据许可证和门控、环境与 benchmark 版本、rollout 与拒绝日志、reward 定义、校准结果和有记录的重叠协议。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Separate public weights and software from released, gated, private-third-party, and NVIDIA-internal training material.
  • Treat developer recipes as open-subset reference implementations, not evidence that the reported proprietary-data results are reproducible.
  • Record multi-environment RL by task family, environment version, terminal predicate, reward, rollout policy, and calibration; most of these are still incomplete here.
  • Preserve the two Nano data-scale statements: 141 datasets and 10.648T tokens in the table, versus approximately 25T training tokens in the text.
  • Keep this as a Track 12 disclosure ledger, not a Track 8 reusable-RL-recipe classification.

• 将公开权重和软件与已发布、门控、私有第三方及 NVIDIA 内部训练材料分开记录。
  • 将开发者 recipe 视为开源子集的 reference implementation，而不是报告中专有数据结果可复现的证据。
  • 按任务族、环境版本、终止谓词、reward、rollout policy 和校准记录多环境 RL；其中大部分在此仍不完整。
  • 保留两种 Nano 数据规模陈述：表中为 141 个数据集和 10.648T token，正文为约 25T 训练 token。
  • 将其保留为 Track 12 披露账本，而不是 Track 8 可复用 RL recipe 分类。
